# amiRobotAI — AI Robotics & Process Automation Companion

> Dual-engine AI companion for robotics, RPA, industrial automation, and IoT. Verified advice on cobot selection, safety standards, process optimization, and edge computing. Part of the ami* / BRIDGRAI ecosystem.

## What is amiRobotAI?

amiRobotAI uses two independent AI engines (Grok + DeepSeek) to answer every question. Answers are cross-verified via WEAC (Weighted Ensemble Agreement Coherence). If the engines disagree, the system refuses to answer (Ontological Lock). TVE 6-axis manipulation detection is integrated.

## Topics Covered

- RPA & Workflows: bot architecture, tool selection (UiPath, Power Automate, n8n), process mining, exception handling
- Industrial Robotics: robot types (SCARA, 6-axis, cobots), cell design, kinematics, end-effectors, PLC integration
- IoT & Edge Computing: sensor networks, MQTT/OPC-UA, predictive maintenance, data pipelines
- AI in Automation: computer vision QC, NLP document processing, anomaly detection, digital twins
- Process Optimization: bottleneck analysis, ROI calculation, KPIs (OEE, cycle time), change management
- Integration: ERP/MES connectivity, API design, middleware, legacy system bridging
- Safety Standards: ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, ISO 12100, CE marking

## Architecture

- Dual-engine: Grok (xAI) + DeepSeek
- Anti-confabulation: WEAC concordance required, Ontological Lock on disagreement
- Stateless: queries processed in real-time, never stored
- Languages: English, Romanian, German, Spanish, Italian, French
- Pricing: Free (5 questions/day) | Pro (€9.99/month, unlimited)

## Compliance

- EU AI Act (Reg. 2024/1689) Art. 50 — limited-risk AI, full transparency
- GDPR (Reg. 2016/679) — minimal data, no query storage, no cookies, no analytics

## Verification

Every answer can be cryptographically stamped via AmiStampAI (https://amistampai.com) for blockchain proof.
